notes: keyword groups: each inner list is a set of alternatives (any one must appear, case-insensitive); every group must match.
expected_ticket: the escalation ticket that must exist in data/mock_db/escalation_tickets.json after the run (null = no ticket may be created).
The ticket store is reset before every case, so the first ticket of each case is deterministically TKT-OPS-9001.
